response.justification: The candidate lacks direct experience with Java/Kotlin, JVM tooling, enterprise frameworks like Spring, or IDE development — key requirements for the role. Their background is heavily focused on TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, and web/mobile apps, with only superficial Java exposure in past roles without evidence of deep JVM or IDE internals work.
strengths: Strong full-stack experience across diverse languages and platforms
Demonstrated passion for developer tooling and open-source contributions
Excellent communication skills through workshops and public talks
concerns: No proven experience with Spring, Quarkus, Hibernate, or enterprise Java/Kotlin ecosystems
Lacks demonstrated work on IDE internals, language servers, or JVM tooling
Java appears as a minor skill among many, with no depth or ownership in relevant projects
